faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Dell Latitude 7200 2-in-1 and 7210 2-in-1. The part number on the back of your current keyboard (K18M or 24D3M) is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is this backlit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is the backlit version in a US (QWERTY) layout.
